fit: cranberry extract in a mixed snack and depression scores during simulated altitude
assessment: POMS depression was higher in both high-altitude conditions than low altitude, with no detected difference between same-altitude mixture and placebo. HADS depression had no detected condition, time or interaction. A preliminary abstract based on the low-altitude contrast is from the same cohort. Cranberry was one of multiple ingredients and the adults did not have Parkinson disease.

fit: cranberry anthocyanin extract and mouse immobility proxies
assessment: Figure 2 shows no detected change relative to vehicle in tail-suspension or forced-swimming immobility at either extract dose. The animal measures and concentrated extract do not estimate a dried cranberry effect on clinical depression.
